# Set Up
```{r}
library(here)
library(tidyverse)
library(dplyr)
```

# Read relevant datasets
```{r}
here()
party.raw <- read.csv("./Data/countypres_2000-2024.csv")
violations.raw <- read.csv("./Data/SDWA_PN_VIOLATION_ASSOC.csv")
srf.raw <- read.csv("./Data/DW Assistance Provided.csv")

PWS.raw <- read.csv("./SDWA_PUB_WATER_SYSTEMS.csv") 

filefolder <- here('Data')

srf_files <- dir(filefolder, pattern = "srf_state_*.*", full.names = TRUE)

srf_data_2015to2025 <- srf_files %>% 
  map(read_csv) %>% 
  bind_rows()

srf_2021 <- read.csv(here("./Data/srf_state_2021.csv"))
srf_2022 <- read.csv(here("./Data/srf_state_2022.csv"))
srf_2023 <- read.csv(here("./Data/srf_state_2023.csv"))
srf_2024 <- read.csv(here("./Data/srf_state_2024.csv"))
srf_2025 <- read.csv(here("./Data/srf_state_2025.csv"))

srf_data_2021to2025 <- bind_rows(list(srf_2021, srf_2022, srf_2023, srf_2024, srf_2025))

srf_data_2023to2025 <- bind_rows(list(srf_2023, srf_2024, srf_2025))

```

# Data cleaning
```{r}
party.clean <- party.raw %>% 
  filter(year %in% c(2020, 2021, 2022, 2023, 2024)) %>% 
  select("state","county_name","year","state_po","county_fips","party")

violations.raw$PWSID1 <- substring(violations.raw$PWSID,1,2) #The first two digits are country code
violations.clean <- violations.raw %>% 
   # filter(PWSID1 == "NC") %>% #only filtered to NC for now
  select("PWSID","VIOLATION_CODE") 
  select("PWSID","VIOLATION_CODE","PWSID1") 

rows <- srf.raw[4,]
rows <- as.vector(rows)
srf <- srf.raw[-c(1:4),]
colnames(srf) <- rows

srf.clean <- srf %>% 
  select("State","Amount of New Funding")
srf.clean$`Amount of New Funding` <- as.numeric(gsub("\\,","",srf.clean$`Amount of New Funding`))

PWS.clean <- PWS.raw %>% 
  select("PWSID", "PWS_NAME","EPA_REGION","STATE_CODE")

violation.pws <- left_join(violations.clean,PWS.clean, by = c("PWSID" = "PWSID"))



violation.pws <- violation.pws %>%
   mutate(across(c(STATE_CODE, PWSID1), ~na_if(., "")))
violation.pws <- drop_na(violation.pws)

#SRF Amount 2015-2025
srfcolnames <- c("State", "Amount")
colnames(srf_data_2015to2025) <- srfcolnames

srf_data_2015to2025 <- srf_data_2015to2025 %>% 
  group_by(State) %>% 
  summarize(total = sum(Amount))

colnames(srf_data_2015to2025) <- srfcolnames

srf_data_2015to2025 <- srf_data_2015to2025 %>% 
  mutate(Amount.mil = Amount/1000000)

#SRF Amount 2021-2025
colnames(srf_data_2021to2025) <- srfcolnames

srf_data_2021to2025 <- srf_data_2021to2025 %>% 
  group_by(State) %>% 
  summarize(total = sum(Amount))

colnames(srf_data_2021to2025) <- srfcolnames

srf_data_2021to2025 <- srf_data_2021to2025 %>% 
  mutate(Amount.mil = Amount/1000000)

#SRF Amount 2021-2025
colnames(srf_data_2023to2025) <- srfcolnames

srf_data_2023to2025 <- srf_data_2023to2025 %>% 
  group_by(State) %>% 
  summarize(total = sum(Amount))

colnames(srf_data_2023to2025) <- srfcolnames

srf_data_2023to2025 <- srf_data_2023to2025 %>% 
  mutate(Amount.mil = Amount/1000000)

# EPA regions
srf_data_2015to2025 <- srf_data_2015to2025 %>% 
  mutate(EPA.region = case_when(State %in% c("Connecticut", "Maine", 
                                             "Massachusetts", "New Hampshire", 
                                             "Rhode Island", "Vermont") ~ "Region 1",
                                State %in% c("New Jersey", "New York", 
                                             "Puerto Rico") ~ "Region 2",
                                State %in% c("Delaware", "Washington DC", 
                                             "Maryland", "Pennsylvania", 
                                             "Virginia", "West Virginia") ~ "Region 3",
                                State %in% c("Alabama", "Florida", "Georgia", 
                                             "Kentucky", "Mississippi", 
                                             "North Carolina", "South Carolina", 
                                             "Tennessee") ~ "Region 4",
                                State %in% c("Illinois", "Indiana", 
                                             "Michigan", "Minnesota", 
                                             "Ohio", "Wisconsin") ~ "Region 5",
                                State %in% c("Arkansas", "Louisiana", 
                                             "New Mexico", "Oklahoma", 
                                             "Texas") ~ "Region 6",
                                State %in% c("Iowa", "Kansas", 
                                             "Missouri", "Nebraska") ~ "Region 7",
                                State %in% c("Colorado", "Montana", 
                                             "North Dakota", "South Dakota", 
                                             "Utah", "Wyoming") ~ "Region 8",
                                State %in% c("Arizona", "California", 
                                             "Hawaii", "Nevada") ~ "Region 9",
                                State %in% c("Alaska", "Idaho", 
                                             "Oregon", "Washington") ~ "Region 10"))

```

# Initial figure creation
```{r}
#ggplot(srf.clean, aes(x = `Amount of New Funding`))+
 # geom_histogram()

violation_state <- ggplot(violation.pws,aes(as.factor(x = STATE_CODE)))+
  geom_bar()+
  theme_bw()+
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 60, hjust = 0.8))+
  labs(title = "Drinking Water Violations in 2025 by State",
       x = "State",
       y = "Count")
violation_state
ggsave(violation_state,
       filename = "MaYBurkeSLimEFig2.jpg",
       height = 15,
       width = 40,
       units = "cm")
```

```{r}
EPAregion_amt <- ggplot(srf_data_2015to2025, 
                        aes(x = EPA.region, 
                            y = Amount.mil)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
  theme_bw()
  
state_amt <-  ggplot(srf_data_2015to2025, 
                        aes(x = State, 
                            y = Amount.mil)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, vjust = 0.5)) +
  labs(y = "Amount (in millions USD)",
       title = "Drinking Water State Revolving Funds Assistance provided from 2015 - 2025 by State")

ggsave(state_amt,
       filename = "MaYBurkeSLimEFig1.jpg",
       height = 15,
       width = 40,
       units = "cm")
```
